fidelity: Enlarged dark grey unpowered training chain assembled in a fixed toothed service former. Nine physical teeth locate resting link windows. The yellow two-pin connector starts loose on the table and is placed into an empty cradle before both bare end links are joined and retained with the blue keeper supplied from the left. Central 30mm-long side-rail sections are 20mm high for natural finger contact, without separate grasp posts. No powered-drive, OEM, rated-load, vibration-locking or spring-clip claim.
runtime_configuration: Standard PhysX actuator path (sim.use_newton_actuators=False) with passive task hinges and normal fourteen robot joint/gripper controls.
reference_controller: Fixed 20 Hz fourteen-command robot program calibrated in earlier simulator-assisted development; elapsed-time input only in actual native re-execution. Calibration provenance is in chain_link/motions/*.json. No live object-pose or scoring feedback.
